notes.title: Community Message & Patch Fix
notes.content:
[h1]To Community[/h1]

Dear Players,

We at Starpixel apologize for the issues at launch. We understand your frustration and are working hard to fix the problems. 

The localization patch had broken a few routes and gameplay features, we have heard your feedback and hope this can alleviate your frustrations you have of the product.

Thank you for your patience and support.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Removed buggy temple door interacter
- Tweaked some event frequencies.
- Player thoughts not appearing
- Ending 2 softlock is fixed
- Ending 2 main menu at scene start removed

notes.title: Chinese Language & Minor fixes
notes.content:
[h2]First of all, thank you everyone for buying our game![/h2]

We've been hard at work localizing the game for Chinese players days before launch.

As with any release, we know there may be a few bumps along the way, and we would like to ensure that your gameplay experience is as immersive as possible.

This Day 1 patch addresses some initial issues.

[list]
[*] [b]Added Chinese Language Support & language options[/b]
[*] Fixed Note immediately appearing on Day 2
[*] Reduced frequency of some events
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the game :>
